top_stories.title: Paris Playbook summit debates a more integrated Europe

sources.headline: Paris Playbook Live: Gabriel Attal pushes for a United States of Europe

top_stories.title: EU challenges US diesel export threat
top_stories.summary: The European Union launched a diplomatic offensive against the threat of a US diesel export ban. The threat met mixed responses in Europe facing fuel constraints.

top_stories.title: AI security debate moves beyond US leadership
top_stories.summary: Technology leaders urged caution on AI development at the United Nations, warning of severe risks. A separate analysis argued that securing AI may require action beyond the United States.

top_stories.title: Zelensky frames the war's spread at the UN
